responsibility: Declares the OpenBSD-specific driver options recognized by GCC’s generated option machinery: assert=, posix, and pthread. This file is the option-table companion to openbsd.h, providing command-line metadata so those OS-level switches can participate in specs expansion and driver decoding rather than implementing the specs themselves.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/openbsd.h, which encodes the OpenBSD target behavior through macros and specs, this file only lists the OpenBSD command-line options for the generated option machinery and does not implement the OS configuration itself.
